title: NEB Class 11 Mathematics — Vectors — 2023
subject: mathematics
source: NEB Grade 11 Model Questions / NEB Past Papers 2020-2024

questions.question: If a = 2i + 3j - k and b = i - j + 2k, find a·b and |a × b|.
questions.knowledgeNote: Dot product gives scalar; cross product gives vector perpendicular to both a and b.

questions.question: The scalar projection of the vector $\mathbf{a}=(2,-1,4)$ on the vector $\mathbf{b}=(1,2,-2)$ is (a) $-\frac{8}{3}$  (b) $\frac{8}{3}$  (c) $-\frac{8}{9}$  (d) $8$
questions.knowledgeNote: Scalar projection divides $\mathbf{a}\cdot\mathbf{b}$ by $|\mathbf{b}|$; vector projection divides it by $|\mathbf{b}|^{2}$.
